Prior-year comparable quarter = 2025-06-30 = fiscal Q1 FY2026, accession 0000017313-25-000076.

risk_rating_migration.scale: 1 to 5 (NOT 1-4). 1 = least risk / above underwriting; 2 = performing as expected (all new loans rated 2); 3 = below expectations, generally still on accrual; 4 = materially below, typically on non-accrual, no expectation of significant principal loss; 5 = materially below, on non-accrual, expectation of significant principal loss.
risk_rating_migration.basis: Debt investments at fair value. Ratings explicitly do NOT apply to equity investments.
risk_rating_migration.direction: Mildly IMPROVING on a percentage basis. Rating 3 fell 10.9% -> 10.1% of the debt portfolio; Rating 5 fell from $2.3M (0.1%) to $0.5M (0.0%); Rating 1 held at 18.8% and Rating 2 rose 68.9% -> 69.8%. Ratings 4+5 combined: 1.4% -> 1.3%. In DOLLARS, Rating 4 rose $25.1M -> $26.9M and criticized (3+4+5) fell $234.5M -> $227.8M against a debt book that grew $83.4M, so the improvement is partly denominator growth from new originations that enter at Rating 2.

top20_note: Ranked by total borrower fair value, all tranches aggregated. 'par' and 'fv_pct_of_par' are computed on DEBT tranches only - equity co-investments carry no par and would otherwise inflate the ratio (e.g. ITA Holdings shows 135% FV/cost only because of a $28.6M equity stake on a $64.9M loan marked at par). Debt and equity cost/FV are reported separately for this reason. Top 20 = 35.4% of portfolio fair value. Names are verbatim from the SOI; where CSWC's own tagging used punctuation variants across debt and equity rows, all variants are listed in name_variants_in_filing.

structural_notes.management_structure: INTERNALLY MANAGED. CSWC pays NO external investment advisory fee and NO incentive fee of any kind - it directly bears the cost of employing its investment professionals. There is therefore NO NII-keyed incentive-fee mechanic, no hurdle rate, no catch-up, and no total-return or capital-loss lookback to extract. This is a structural difference from every externally-managed BDC and removes the standard fee-driven incentive to inflate NII. Note for the cohort: MAIN is likewise internally managed, so BOTH of the highest premium-to-NAV names in this tier share this structure.
structural_notes.operating_expense_ratio: LTM operating expenses excluding interest as a percentage of LTM average total assets: 1.36% at 2026-06-30 versus 1.69% at 2025-06-30.

asset_coverage.headroom_note: 209% vs the 150% statutory floor. CSWC holds an SEC exemptive order (2021-08-11) permitting exclusion of SBIC subsidiary senior securities from the asset-coverage calculation - the 209% is computed on that exempted basis, so it overstates coverage relative to a BDC without SBIC relief.
asset_coverage.covenant: Credit facilities separately require regulatory asset coverage of not less than a specified level; facility-level covenant threshold not restated numerically in the excerpt reviewed.

unfunded_commitments.note: $312.1M of unfunded commitments against $1,058.5M of net assets - 29.5% of NAV. Includes revolvers, delayed-draw term loans and letters of credit issued through a financial intermediary on behalf of portfolio companies.

structural_notes.i45_slf_status: DISSOLVED. I-45 SLF LLC - the joint venture between CSWC and MAIN STREET CAPITAL CORPORATION - was dissolved and liquidated, with CSWC receiving distributions-in-kind of the underlying investments. I-45 appears twice in the June-2025 10-Q and ZERO times in the June-2026 10-Q. This directly affects the cross-manager borrower match: former I-45 assets now sit directly on CSWC's balance sheet AND on MAIN's, so apparent CSWC/MAIN borrower overlap may be a legacy of the shared JV rather than independent origination.

structural_notes.strategy: Internally managed BDC investing in LOWER MIDDLE MARKET ('LMM') companies, primarily first lien debt, frequently with equity co-investment alongside. CSWC does NOT report a Lower/Upper Middle Market segmentation in this filing.
structural_notes.litigation_overhang: Holders of the 2029 Convertible Notes assert CSWC was required to adjust the conversion rate when it began paying its $0.58 regular quarterly dividend in three monthly $0.1934 installments starting July 2025. Letters received from noteholder counsel 2026-06-04 and 2026-07-10. CSWC disputes the claim. Adverse resolution would be dilutive - relevant because the diluted share count (70.5M) already exceeds basic (61.1M) by 15%.

Non-accrual portfolio-company COUNT is not stated by CSWC. MD&A gives only cost/FV percentages. The count of 8 obligors (14 tranches) is derived by summing SOI lines carrying footnote (16); it is a derived figure, not a disclosed one.

Distribution dollar total for the quarter ended 2025-12-31 was not restated in dollars in the December 10-Q excerpt reviewed; the per-share components ($0.1934 x 3 monthly regular + $0.06 supplemental) ARE disclosed and are used. distribution_per_share_last4 total_usd is null for that quarter only.

Cumulative undistributed taxable income (spillover) is disclosed as of 2026-03-31 ($64.5M / $1.07 per share) in the FY2026 10-K, NOT as of 2026-06-30. No updated spillover figure is given in the June-2026 10-Q. The figure is one quarter stale.

Realized-gain decomposition is disclosed by control category and net of tax, but CSWC does not attribute realized losses to named borrowers, so realized losses cannot be tied to specific non-accrual names.

Facility-level covenant asset-coverage threshold is referenced in the credit agreement summary but the specific numeric covenant level was not restated in the passage reviewed; only the 1940 Act 150% floor and the 166% board resolution are quantified.

Internal risk ratings cover DEBT investments only. Equity investments - which are 67.4% penetrated across the portfolio and represent the entire gap between the $2,202.3M total portfolio and the $1,999.9M rated debt book (~$202M, 9.2% of FV) - are UNRATED. There is no disclosed migration signal for roughly a tenth of the portfolio.

PIK is disclosed as PIK INTEREST income. Any PIK-equivalent accrual embedded in dividend income from equity/preferred positions is not separately broken out and is not included in the PIK figures reported here.

No borrower-level industry is disclosed for a small number of SOI lines that fall on page-table boundaries; industry was carried forward from the preceding section header in document order. Spot-checked against the SOI section headings and consistent, but it is a derived attribution, not a per-row tag.
